args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight shirts and dresses
- Shorts and swimsuits
- Light hiking shoes
- Quick-dry clothes
- Hiking gear

### Beach Essentials
- Sunscreen
- Beach towels
- Flip-flops
- Sunglasses
- Hat

### Electronics
- Camera
- Portable charger
- Headphones
- Power bank

### Toiletries
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body soap
- Deodorant
- Towels

### Other
- Water bottle
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Beach blanket
- Sun hat
- Travel adapter

## Tips
- Pack a reusable water bottle
- Bring a beach towel
- Pack a travel-sized first aid kit
- Pack a lightweight umbrella
- Pack a beach chair

## Additional Notes
- Pack a reusable shopping bag
- Bring a beach umbrella
- Pack a beach towel
- Pack a beach chair
- Pack a travel-sized first aid kit
- Pack a reusable water bottle
